summary.pack_description:
Celebrate the players who brought heart and soul to the ice with the Heart & Soul: 80s + 90s Debut LE Pack! Relive great plays from fan-favorite players whose passion and grit defined their teams. These highlights showcase the unforgettable energy and excitement of 80s and 90s hockey.

Each pack contains 2 highlights from Heart & Soul: 80s + 90s, and 1 mystery highlight that could be from Fresh Sweaters: Legacy (77.9%), Opening Ice: Icons (20%), Cause for a Celly: 2000s (2%), or The Greatest Achievements (< 1%)

release.name: Heart & Soul: 80s + 90s Debut LE Pack
release.description:
Sale Starts: Thursday, Oct 9 at 1pm ET / 10am PT

Price: $9 USD

# Packs Available: 5000 packs total. Edition numbers are distributed randomly.

Purchase Limit: Twenty (20) pack limit per person for the first 6 hours; the limit increases to a seventy-five (75) pack limit per person afterward. Once the “Buy Now” process has started, users will have 10 minutes to complete checkout before the pack(s) is released for another collector to purchase.

 

Highlights Per Pack: 3

Pack Contents (Highlight Rarity, Edition Size):

  • Two (2) highlights from Heart & Soul: 80s + 90s (Core #/1500)
  • One (1) highlight with the following probabilities:
    • 77.9% Fresh Sweaters: Legacy (Limited #/500)
    • 20% Opening Ice: Icons (Rare #/250)
    • 2% Cause for a Celly: 2000s (Epic #/100)
    • 0.1% The Greatest Achievements (Legendary #/10)

 

Payment Methods Accepted: Most major credit and debit cards. Payments will be processed via Stripe. 

Fan Marketplace: Packs and highlights are eligible to be sold to other collectors in the NHL Breakaway fan marketplace. See FAQ.

Transferability: Packs and highlights can be exchanged in the Trade Lounge™ with other NHL Breakaway users.

Blockchain: Polygon

 

Sets Included:

  • Highlights List
  • Heart & Soul: 80s + 90s, Series 3 - Preview
  • Fresh Sweaters: Legacy, Series 3 - Preview
  • Opening Ice: Icons, Series 3 - Preview
  • Cause for a Celly: 2000s, Series 3 - Preview
  • The Greatest Achievements, Series 3 - Preview

 

Collection Guarantee: Series 3 highlights will only be distributed during Series 3, which ends prior to the start of the 2026-27 Regular Season. We will not issue more than the edition limit we have set. Any editions not distributed in packs will not be distributed after the series end date (See FAQ for “Uncirculated Editions”)

 

All sales subject to Terms

summary.name: Heart & Soul: 80s + 90s
summary.description: Celebrate the players who brought heart and soul to the ice with the Heart & Soul: 80s + 90s set! Relive great moments from fan-favorite players whose passion and grit defined their teams. These highlights showcase the unforgettable energy and excitement of 80s and 90s hockey.

summary.name: Heart & Soul: 80s + 90s
summary.description: Celebrate the players who brought heart and soul to the ice with the Heart & Soul: 80s + 90s set! Relive great moments from fan-favorite players whose passion and grit defined their teams. These highlights showcase the unforgettable energy and excitement of 80s and 90s hockey.

summary.name: Fresh Sweaters: Legacy
summary.description: Celebrate the thrill of new beginnings with the Fresh Sweaters: Legacy Limited set—spotlighting legendary players as they suited up for NHL teams you wouldn’t typically associate them with in most cases. These highlights capture iconic names taking the ice in unfamiliar colors, leaving their mark in unexpected places.

summary.name: Opening Ice: Icons
summary.description: Opening Ice: Icons is a Rare set that immortalizes the unforgettable moments when legendary players scored their first NHL goals or goalies secured their first NHL win. Relive the sheer joy and determination as these icons achieve their first milestone in the NHL. Opening Ice: Icons celebrates the origins of hockey’s great heroes and commemorates the beginnings of remarkable careers.

summary.name: Cause for a Celly: 2000s
summary.description: Cause for a Celly: 2000s, an Epic set that celebrates unforgettable NHL playoff moments that helped define the decade. From legendary players to game-changing plays—overtime winners, Game 7 heroics, and more—this Epic set captures the intensity, drama, and passion of postseason hockey at its finest.

summary.name: The Greatest Achievements
summary.description: Hockey’s history is rich with legendary players, unforgettable plays, and cherished memories. Yet every so often, something truly extraordinary occurs—like a record-shattering milestone or a Stanley Cup–winning goal from a franchise icon. These achievements capture the hockey world and become timeless pieces of the sport’s legacy. The Greatest Achievements honors these moments as part of the NHL Breakaway collection.
